protocol.claim_boundary: second-order local model-check on reused horizon cases; no independent replication, evidence-code, functional memory, causal-channel or chaos claim
protocol.comparison: report sign and size of incremental residual reduction in every seed-axis-horizon cell; stable reduction supports ordinary local curvature as part of the first-order error
protocol.denominator: same evaluation A-cloud RMS as earlier gates
protocol.derivative_validation: one predeclared first same-order heldout direction per seed/horizon, central second difference; fail run if relative Hessian discrepancy exceeds tolerance
protocol.descriptive_threshold: <=0.1 relative full residual across every seed/axis at a horizon; h16 is extrapolative stress, not a selected success condition
protocol.falsifier: second order fails to consistently reduce the first-order error or misses threshold; no third/higher-order search follows failure
protocol.independent_unit: same four parameter realizations; reused histories/horizons are dependent scope characterization
protocol.prediction: G_h(mu)+DG_h(mu)*d+0.5*D2G_h(mu)[d,d] using float64 directional autodiff; coefficient0.5 fixed by Taylor formula
protocol.reference: identical fixed training A centroid and source cases; no relinearization, fitted correction or target-state information
protocol.targets: hash-verified cached nonlinear float32 continuations; exact history index pairing verified
